description: New 'Evolução' tab with a Chart.js line chart of the three pillar averages (hard/soft/discipline) per quarter for a selected member, plus the quarter-bar/evolution CSS, the console.assert self-tests for migration and period calc, and (only if time remains) the bonus previous-quarter overlays on the radar and Nine Box drift. Visible to leader and collaborator (collaborator sees own data only). Depends on FEAT-001 (period helpers + period-aware Model) and FEAT-002 (selectedPeriod state and quarter bar).
steps:
In index.html: add nav item after the Plano item: . Add
with a .view-head (h2 'Evolução' +
In js/app.js: register 'evolution' in switchView (call renderEvolution()) and in reloadAndRender when it is the active view. Add `let evolutionChart = null;` and `let evolutionSelectedId = null;`.

Add populateEvolutionSelect() mirroring populatePlanSelect(): leader picks any member; collaborator sees only self (hide/disable the select when !canEdit() and list length <= 1). Wire its change handler to set evolutionSelectedId and re-render.

Add renderEvolution(): resolve the member; if none, show #evolution-empty with the appropriate message. Build the sorted ascending list of that member's period keys from Object.keys(member.periods||{}) (fallback: if empty, use [Store.currentPeriodKey()]). For each pillar in Model.PILLARS build a dataset: data = periodKeys.map(k => Model.pillarAverage(member, pillar, k)), borderColor/backgroundColor from pillar.color, label = pillar.name. Destroy evolutionChart if set, then new Chart(canvas, { type:'line', data:{ labels: periodKeys, datasets }, options:{ responsive:true, maintainAspectRatio:false, scales:{ y:{ min:0, max:Model.SCALE_MAX, ticks:{color:'#64748b'} }, x:{ ticks:{color:'#64748b'} } }, plugins:{ legend:{ labels:{ color:'#94a3b8' } } } } }).

In styles.css: add .quarter-bar (display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; and right-align within view-head e.g. margin-left:auto to match .view-head .select), .q-nav button styling (small, reuse .btn look or a compact variant using --surface-2/--border/--text), .q-label (color:var(--text); font-weight:600; min-width for YYYY-Qn). Add .evolution-wrap { position:relative; height: 360px; } mirroring .ninebox-wrap sizing. Reuse existing CSS variables only; keep the dark theme.

Add console.assert self-tests, guarded to run only when location.search includes 'selftest' (so real data is never touched). Place in js/store.js after window.Store is set (so both Store and Model are available) OR in app.js boot; whichever runs after Model loads. Operate on SYNTHETIC objects: (a) legacy member {id:'t', scores:{hard:{'Cloud / AWS':4,'CI/CD':2}}, plan:[{id:'o',title:'x',tasks:[]}]} passed through the migrate-on-read helper gains periods[Store.currentPeriodKey()] with the same scores and plan; (b) a new member {id:'t2', periods:{'2025-Q1':{scores:{},plan:[]}}} is unchanged (still has no root scores, periods['2025-Q1'] intact); (c) Model.pillarAverage(migratedLegacy, Model.PILLARS[0], Store.currentPeriodKey()) === (4+2)/6 (sum over the 6 hard competencies divided by 6). Use console.assert(cond, 'FEAT-003 selftest: <msg>').

BONUS (only if the three core deliverables above are done and verified, else skip): in drawRadar add a faint previous-quarter dataset using Model.memberScoresByCompetency(member, pillar, shiftPeriod(selectedPeriod,-1)) when that period exists on the member; in renderNineBox draw a light connector line from each member's previous-quarter point to the current point when the previous period exists. Guard so missing previous data is a no-op and never throws. Keep this strictly secondary to the line chart.
acceptance_criteria: index.html contains a nav-item with data-view='evolution' and a section with id='view-evolution'; clicking the tab shows the view.
The Evolução view renders a Chart.js line chart with three datasets (one per pillar) for the selected member; a member with scores in >=2 quarters plots one point per quarter per pillar.
Collaborator sees only their own evolution (member select hidden/disabled); leader can switch members.
Opening http://localhost:8080/?selftest runs the console.assert tests and NONE fail (no 'Assertion failed' in console); loading without ?selftest does not run them.
The quarter bar and Evolução chart are styled consistently with the dark theme (no unstyled/overflowing elements).
verification: Open http://localhost:8080, click the Evolução tab, confirm the line chart renders without console errors.
Create/ensure a member has scores in two different quarters (use FEAT-002 quarter switching), then confirm the three pillar lines each show a point per quarter.
Open http://localhost:8080/?selftest and confirm all FEAT-003 self-test asserts pass (none fail) in the console.
Regression: confirm Time, Avaliação, Nine Box, Plano, Usuários (incl. the delete button) and Tutorial still work and the title still reads 'PDI Cloud'.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED in index.html, styles.css, js/app.js and js/store.js (NO changes to js/model.js, firebase-config.js, firestore.rules). Three core deliverables done and verified; BONUS (previous-quarter radar overlay + Nine Box drift) intentionally SKIPPED to keep the change focused and avoid regressing the already-passing radar/Nine Box views (spec marks it strictly secondary / only-if-time).
